verdict.rationale: The product's own transcription accepts natural-language formatting instructions with the audio and returns already-formatted text (assemblyai-docs-4, assemblyai-docs-24), and contextual prompting is documented (assemblyai-docs-14). This gives narrow natural-language control over output only. The documented MCP server serves docs lookups for coding agents (assemblyai-docs-11, assemblyai-probe-4), and the agent-instruction files are integration aids (assemblyai-docs-10); neither lets a user operate the product itself, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: natural-language operation of jobs, account, or settings (e.g. an operational MCP server or agent interface); evidence of NL control beyond output formatting; independent or hands-on corroboration.
